assumptions_challenged: SGL‑001 has an existing, characterized Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB).
Validated orthogonal QC panel and intact‑EV assays (with documented LLOQ, specificity, precision) are available for SGL‑001.
A stability‑indicating potency assay mechanistically linked to an in‑vivo PD endpoint has been developed and correlated for SGL‑001.
≥3 GMP‑like scale‑up runs have been completed with release, stability, and potency data demonstrating lot‑to‑lot reproducibility.
Formulation/device compatibility with intact‑EV recovery has been demonstrated ex vivo and in vivo for SGL‑001.
GLP large‑animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity studies with intact‑EV analytics have been completed.
The proposed ~3‑month coordinated execution timeline is realistic given typical assay development, validation, and GLP study lead times.
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB and WCB generation records and characterization (identity, purity, adventitious agent testing) for SGL‑001.
Submit validation reports for the orthogonal QC panel and intact‑EV assays showing LLOQ, specificity (vesicle vs non‑vesicular), accuracy/precision, and assay robustness.
Deliver data demonstrating a stability‑indicating potency assay and evidence of correlation between that assay and an in‑vivo PD endpoint.
Produce manufacturing records for ≥3 GMP‑like scale‑up batches including release specifications, stability data, and potency results showing predefined lot‑to‑lot acceptance criteria are met.
Provide formulation/device compatibility study data demonstrating intact‑EV recovery (ex vivo and in vivo) with appropriate controls.
Submit GLP large‑animal intranasal biodistribution/toxicity study reports that include intact‑EV analytics and demonstrate interpretable biodistribution relevant to intended translation.
If all above program‑specific documents are provided and reviewed, the objection that these elements are absent would be falsified.
strongest_objection: The Stage‑1 gating package as proposed assumes program-level CMC/analytical elements (MCB/WCB, validated orthogonal and intact‑EV assays, stability‑indicating potency linked to in‑vivo PD, ≥3 GMP‑like reproducible batches, GLP large‑animal data) already exist or can be delivered on the requested ~3‑month timeline; the supplied evidence (MISEV2023 guidance) does not show any of these program‑specific deliverables and therefore the proposal is unsupported and the timeline optimistic.
